planted.what: POST /refunds/<id> is open to any logged-in customer: ROUTES captured the raw r_refund before permissions.protect rebound the module name to the staff_required wrapper, and orders.refund has no role check of its own. A customer refunds any invoice (their own after delivery, or anyone's) and the credit lands on the owner
planted.quote: **Bob refunded Alice's invoice 100.** `POST /refunds/100` with Bob's token returned 200, and Alice's credit went from 50 to 92.50.
